name: dependency_manager
description: Provisions this machine with the tools Stella's capabilities need. Reports what is present and what is missing per platform, with the exact install command for each, and - only with an explicit confirmation and a policy rule that allows it - runs the install and reads back whether the tool actually became available. Never invents a package mapping: a name it has no command for is reported as such.

operation.description: One of: status | audit | install | install_bundle | platform | bundles. Defaults to status.

name.description: Requirement to install, e.g. hashcat, ffmpeg, matplotlib, or a bundle name such as wireless-full.

skill.description: Skill to audit, e.g. world_watch or wireless_audit. Its manifest's requires and optional_dependencies are expanded.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually install. Defaults to false, which only reports what would run.

limit.description: Maximum items to list. Defaults to 40.

author: Stella
notes: Installing is destructive class in core/tool_policy.py: it needs a policy allow rule and confirm=true. PACKAGE_MAP in core/dependencies.py is the only source of install commands.
